In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the OBA has been widely adopted by the local tertiary institution as an educational policy, but the implementation of OBA has been inconsistent and varied across different institutions.
the OBA has been implemented in the sub-degree sector, but the interpretation and implementation of OBA varies among teachers.
OBA is an approach that is not easy to implement and it is not a one size fits all approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the implementation of OBA in the sub-degree sector should be more flexible and considerate of teachers’ needs and students’ special educational needs.
teachers’ perceptions on OBA are not consistent with that of the policy-makers.
the implementation of OBA in sub-degree education has been problematic.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the policy of OBA is a double-edged sword.
the OBA policy should not be seen as a “one-size-fits-all” solution.
teachers are not merely implementers of OBA.
